ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

2. When practising Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.

3. When practising Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.

4. When practising Language Use, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Use.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Use.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Use.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Use.

5. When practising Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.

6. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

7. When practising Phonological Awareness: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Fluency.

8. When practising Guided Reading: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)

9. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
